name: Fluxcaler Analytics (Umami)
short_desc: Cookieless web analytics — visits, pages, sources and events of your websites
author: Umami Software
description: Umami is an open-source, privacy-focused web analytics tool (no cookies, no IP stored). Fluxcaler installs it on your server: your visitors' data never leaves it. Database: dedicated 'umami' database in the local Supabase PostgreSQL (fluxcaler-supabase-db), created by the Fluxcaler socle (step A11) before installation. Only the tracker script and the collect endpoint are published (neutral names m.js and /api/m); the Umami interface is not public.

form_fields.label: Umami database password (role umami in fluxcaler-supabase-db, must match the role)
